items.summary: The roughly $5 million transfer also spent the tiny payment used to deliver a court notice to the address in May.

items.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out

items.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
items.summary: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

items.title: U.S. Senate Banking Committee races toward hearing on new SEC nominations
items.summary: The committee that needs to advance President Donald Trump's nominees responded quickly to set his SEC picks for review next week.

items.title: Bitcoin heads for sixth weekly loss as Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO looms
items.summary: Bitcoin is down 21% this year as investors weigh Anthropic’s anticipated listing, Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and rising Fed rate hike expectations.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward says expansion outside crypto trading helps cushion revenue decline
items.summary: While earnings and the company’s newly introduced financial performance measure remained below year-earlier levels, there are signs of improvement from the second quarter.

items.title: Bitcoin's momentum gauge is turning red, could send prices back below $60,000
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 13, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin hits 12-week low as dollar rallies on interest-rate outlook, liquidations top $1.6 billion
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and is down 3.5% since midnight UTC, as the dollar climbs and liquidations top $1.6 billion.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin eyes bear market lows as late summer rally mostly wiped out
items.summary: Equity markets are falling as well, with interest rates and the dollar surging amid an increasingly hawkish Federal Reserve.

items.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

items.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
items.summary: Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.

items.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
items.summary: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
items.summary: OpenAI’s new payment wallet lets AI agents complete purchases using existing card networks, with plans to eventually allow preauthorized transactions.

items.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
items.summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
items.summary: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

items.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
items.summary: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.

items.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
items.summary: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

items.title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
items.summary: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.

items.title: Could a Former Nvidia Executive Replace Jensen Huang? Arm’s Rene Haas Emerges as Candidate
items.summary: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's chief executive as it searches for a replacement for Jensen Huang, while some employees are pushing to bring the chipmaker's founder back as CEO.

items.title: Should Government Officials Be Banned From Prediction Markets? House Oversight Says Maybe
items.summary: A House Oversight staff memorandum, citing suspicious trades by officials, military personnel and clearance holders, recommends Congress weigh new limits on federal personnel betting on platforms like Kalshi and Polymark

items.title: China’s $3.2 Billion AI Pipeline Still Calls for Nvidia Chips Washington Restricts
items.summary: Chinese data center projects are still being designed around restricted Nvidia processors, even as Beijing pushes domestic alternatives.

items.title: JPMorgan’s Bitcoin and Crypto-Linked Holdings Approach $1 Billion
items.summary: The bank’s Q3 13F shows roughly $981 million across Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy and Coinbase—likely over $1 billion counting Robinhood and miners.

items.title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Wake Up After 16 Years, Moving $6.9 Million
items.summary: Two Bitcoin mining rewards from September 2010 moved minutes apart. The coins are worth nearly 1.15 million times their original market value.

items.title: Fed Chair Warsh Wants Answers on AI Inflation—and Bitcoin May Feel the Impact
items.summary: The Federal Reserve is examining whether AI will lower prices or keep inflation elevated, a question that could shape interest rates and the outlook for crypto.

items.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
items.summary: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.

items.title: Bitcoin Hits 12-Week Low as Fed Rate Fears Undo Most of Summer Rally
items.summary: Bitcoin is back near August levels as persistent inflation, growing expectations of another interest-rate hike and ETF withdrawals pressure prices.

items.title: Crypto Laundering a 'Material Risk' for UK Ahead of FATF Review: RUSI
items.summary: Assessors visit in June 2027, months before full crypto rules take effect, leaving the UK to prove it can enforce against crypto laundering.

items.title: ‘Roadmap is Complete,' Cardano Founder Charles Hoskinson Says
items.summary: Cardano's ADA token is down almost 95% from its all-time high, and investors don't seem to be happy that the roadmap is complete.
